content.name: Tessa Whitfield
content.title: Junior Graphic Designer
content.summary: Junior graphic designer with a B.F.A. from Portland State University and a year designing packaging, social content and event graphics for a regional maker marketplace. Strong in Illustrator, InDesign and hand lettering; a redesigned holiday campaign I led drove a 19% lift in online gift-card sales.

experience.title: Graphic Design Intern
bullets: Designed 14 wedding and event invitation suites from client briefs, preparing print-ready files with correct bleeds and Pantone specs.
Set type and locked up plates on the studio's Vandercook press for short runs of 50 to 300 pieces.
Photographed finished work and refreshed 30 portfolio pages on the studio's Squarespace site.

experience.title: Junior Graphic Designer
bullets: Create weekly social posts, email headers and in-store signage for a marketplace representing 85 local makers.
Led the visual concept for the 2025 holiday campaign, which saw online gift-card sales rise 19% year over year.
Built a Canva brand kit and template set so makers can produce on-brand product cards without design help.
Redesigned the label system for the collective's house candle line, cutting print waste by switching to a gang-run sheet layout.
